difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the function on the underlying topological space of a locally Noetherian quasi-separated algebraic space defined by the shift making the dualizing complex normalized at each point is a dimension function (statement lines 485-496). The proof (proof lines 497-522) compares the shifts on affine etale charts using the behaviour of normalized dualizing complexes under unramified extension, identifies the chart dimension function with the composite, and concludes by lifting specializations along the chart. H2: a complete two step reduction.
